line.a_start.text: Deer, quick, come here! There's something under the apple tree again!

line.a_znowu.text: Gifts! Somebody left them for us under the apple tree again.

line.a_kto.text: That's the third time! Who leaves them for us?

line.a_obietnica.text: We must find out who it is. We'll invite them home for apple pie!

line.a_detektywi.text: Let's be detectives! Let's find out what the gifts have in common.

line.a_pomieszane.text: Oh no, the wind blew other things in. The gifts got all mixed up.

line.a_grupuj.text: To check what the gifts have in common, we'll group everything. Grouping means putting together the things that belong together.

line.a_zasada_jedzenie.text: Maybe all the gifts are food? Let's check: food into the bowl, everything else into the box.

line.a_pomylka.text: That one doesn't belong in this group. Try again.

line.a_gdzie_prezenty.text: Look where the gifts with the bows are.

line.a_nie_ta.text: The gifts are in both groups. So it's not about food. Let's try another rule.

line.a_zasada_kolor.text: Or maybe it's about the colour? Red things into the basket, everything else into the box.

line.a_wszystkie_czerwone.text: All the gifts with bows are in the basket. They're all red!

line.a_trop.text: We have a clue! Whoever leaves the gifts really loves red.

line.a_slady.text: Look, red leaves! Laid out like a trail!

line.a_idziemy.text: Let's follow the trail. Maybe it will lead us to whoever leaves the gifts!

line.b_wieje.text: Brr, it's so windy! My ears are cold.

line.b_co_przyda.text: Point to everything that helps against the cold wind.

line.b_nie_grzeje.text: That won't keep you warm. Keep looking.

line.b_ubierz.text: Drag the hat and the scarf onto Squirrel.

line.b_futerko.text: And I have my warm fur.

line.b_las.text: The trail leads into the forest! We're getting closer.

line.b_gdzie_teraz.text: Oh, the forest is so big. Which way now?

line.b_kartka.text: The wind blew something in... It's a map of the forest! Oh no, it tore, and the pieces are scattered in the leaves.

line.b_szukaj_mapy.text: Look for the pieces of the map among the leaves and touch each one.

line.b_mapa_plan.text: The map has three paths of leaves. Whoever leaves the gifts loves red. Let's look for the path of red leaves!

line.b_mapa_gdzie.text: Lead us with your finger along the path of red leaves.

line.b_mapa_nie.text: Other leaves lie on that path. We only follow the red ones!

line.b_mapa_dab.text: To the big oak with a little door! Let's go there!

line.c_drzwi.text: Oh! And it has a red door. This must be the place!

line.c_to_ja.text: Yes, it's me. I really love red.

line.c_wstyd.text: I wanted to be your friend, but I was shy.

line.c_zapraszamy.text: Come over to our home for apple pie!

line.c_balagan.text: Hooray! I'd like to wear my red hat for the visit. But my things are in a mess and I can't find it.

line.c_przytulnie.text: How cosy it is here! Red curtains, a red armchair, a red rug...

line.c_lubie.text: I told you I love red! And here are my hats and scarves. All mixed up.

line.c_pogrupujmy.text: We'll help! We'll group your things: hats into the basket, scarves into the box. Then it will be easy to find.

line.c_pomylka.text: That one doesn't belong in this group.

line.c_gotowy.text: My hat! Thank you. Let's go and have that pie!

line.p_start.text: Detectives must practise! We get a star for every task.

line.p_inny.text: Which one doesn't go with the rest?

line.p_pasuje.text: That one belongs with the others. Look for the different one.

line.d_szarlotka.text: And here's the apple pie! It baked while we were tidying.

line.d_pycha.text: Yummy! New friends and a tidy room. The best day!

line.d_rodzice.text: Play this with your parents: tidy up together, every group in its own place. Then someone hides something that doesn't belong in a group, and you find it!

line.a_wymien.text: An apple, a leaf, a block and a ball. Each one with a golden bow!

line.a_pomoze.text: Maybe that will help us guess who it is!

line.c_dab.text: Look, what a beautiful red oak!

line.c_pytanie.text: Fox! Is it you who leaves us the red gifts?

line.c_dziekujemy.text: You don't have to be shy. Thank you for the gifts! They were lovely.

line.e_witaj.text: Welcome to our home, Fox! The apple pie is still baking.

line.e_balagan.text: Oh dear, what a mess! Books, toys and clothes all over the floor.

line.e_posprzatam.text: I'll tidy up! Everything into one box!

line.e_pilka.text: Fox, let's play ball while the pie is baking! Where's the ball?

line.e_nie_ma.text: Somewhere in the box... But everything in there is mixed up. I can't find it!

line.e_grupujmy.text: I know! Let's group them. Every group gets its own place, and then we'll find everything easily.

line.e_zasada.text: Drag the books onto the window sill, the toys onto the rug and the clothes into the box.

line.e_pomylka.text: That one doesn't belong in this group.

line.e_gdzie_pilka.text: So where should I look for the ball?

line.e_nie_tam.text: There are no toys here. And a ball is a toy.

line.e_jest.text: There it is! I found it straight away. Grouping is great!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for our adventure together! Here's a sticker for your album, to remember it by. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the red hat from Fox. He gave it to us when, as detectives, we found out who was leaving the red gifts.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you soon!

line.a_grupuj_ok.text: Oh! The apples are together and the cones are together.

line.b_zniknely.text: Oh no! The wind piled leaves on the path and the red trail is gone!

line.b_odgarnij.text: Brush the leaves away with your finger. Maybe there's something underneath!

line.b_lapki.text: Paw prints! Somebody walked this way.

line.b_dokad_nie.text: Look which way the paw prints go.

line.b_do_debu.text: To the big oak in the forest! Let's go!

line.b_poskladaj.text: Put the map back together, so we know which way to go.

line.c_komiks_1.text: Every morning I gathered red things and tied golden bows on them.

line.c_komiks_2.text: Then I quietly laid them under the apple tree.

line.c_komiks_3.text: And then I hid behind a tree and watched you being happy.

line.p_wspolne_ok.text: Yes, the red ball! This group has only red things.

line.p_tajna.text: The basket and the chest have a secret rule. Put things in and guess what it is!

line.p_tajna_nie.text: Spat out! That thing doesn't belong in there.

line.p_tajna_ok.text: I've got it! Mushrooms in the basket, and cones in the chest.

line.p_inny_ok.text: Yes, the chestnut! The rest are acorns.

line.p_wymysl.text: Now you make up the rule! Group the leaves and the flags any way you like.

line.p_wymysl_nie.text: That one doesn't go with what's already in there.

line.p_wg_koloru.text: You're grouping by colour: red together and yellow together!

line.p_wg_rodzaju.text: You're grouping by shape: leaves together and flags together!

line.p_inaczej.text: And now group the same things another way!

line.p_inaczej_ok.text: The same things, but quite different groups! You can group in different ways.

line.p_koniec.text: All the stars are shining! We solved the puzzles like real detectives.

line.e_gra.text: Let's play detectives! Close your eyes, and I'll hide something.

line.e_gra_kto.text: What doesn't belong with the toys on the rug?

line.e_gra_nie.text: That's a toy, it belongs here.

line.e_gra_ok.text: The sock! It's clothing, not a toy. Into the box with it!

line.e_szarlotka.text: The pie is ready! Point to everything we need for the pie.

line.e_szarlotka_nie.text: We can't eat pie with that.

line.e_szarlotka_ok.text: A plate, a cup and a spoon. Everything for eating!

line.p_nie_pasuje.text: Look at the group. What do they have in common?

line.b_co_przyda_ok.text: Yes, the hat and the scarf! They keep you warm.

line.c_pogrupowane.text: Hats in the basket, scarves in the box! Now I can see all my hats at once.
